title: Principal divisors in the canonical rational-function field
statement: Let K be any field and let M = FractionRing (Polynomial K), with its canonical K-algebra structure through the constant-polynomial map. For every nonzero g in M there exists a finitely supported integer-valued divisor D on AlgebraicCurve.Place K M such that D(v) = v.ord g for every place v and AlgebraicCurve.Divisor.degree D = 0. Equivalently, AlgebraicCurve.HasPrincipalDivisors K M holds.
